title: UI风格#104 - Bauhaus Print (包豪斯印刷)
description: 创建第104种UI风格：包豪斯印刷风格 - 活字印刷、几何构图、红色点缀。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCZ.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Print style When color palette Then features printer red, ink black, paper white, rule gray
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#E63946 (印刷红), #000000 (墨黑), #FFFFFF (纸白), #808080 (线条灰), #F5F5F5 (新闻灰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Print style When typography Then uses geometric type: Futura, Aktiv Grotesk, orDIN
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Futura (几何), Aktiv Grotesk (正文), DIN (数字)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Print style When layout Then column grid, rule lines, type blocks, margin notes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：栏格系统、线条分隔、铅字块、边注

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Print style When UI elements Then letterpress texture, ink splatter, print registration
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：活字质感、墨迹溅洒、套印效果、印刷注册线

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Print UI When functional Then includes editorial chat, typesetter agents, press stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：编辑聊天、排版代理、印刷统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Bauhaus Print UI When copy Then uses print language: 'Compose', 'Set', 'Print', 'Press'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'COMPOSE. SET. PRINT.'、按钮'SEND'→'SET'、'SUBMIT'→'PRESS'
